findings.title: View-only permission authorizes group creation and movement
findings.description: `canManage()` accepts either `VIEW` or `MANAGE`. Consequently, an administrator granted only all-groups view permission passes `GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup()`’s `requireManage()` check and can create groups or move existing groups to the top level. Require `MANAGE` only and add a regression test denying these operations to view-only administrators.

findings.title: Group enumeration uses authorization resource IDs instead of group IDs
findings.description:
`groupResource.getId()` is an independently generated authorization-resource ID; the group ID is stored in its name. Passing this ID to `hasPermission()` misses the group-specific resource, while returning it causes user membership queries to match nonexistent groups. With all-groups `VIEW_MEMBERS`, this can make user searches and counts return zero despite access being granted.

Additionally, `AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource()` does not assign individual group resources a type, so `findByType("Groups")` skips them entirely. Correct resource discovery and ID mapping, handle the all-groups resource separately, and test both search and count behavior for individual and all-groups member permissions.

Source review only; tests were not executed.
